question: In familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, those due to perforin deficiencies cause:

options.opa: Uncontrolled activation of macrophages and defects in the function of NK cells.
options.opb: Defects of the expression of molecules of the main histocompatibility complex (CPH) of class II.
options.opd: Defects of the mobility of leukocytes.
